title: Acclaimed Fantasy’s Beloved Character Gets a New Look For Latest Project Ahead of Anime’s Return
content: Kusanagi Mizuho’s beloved shojo manga, Yona of the Dawn , reached its conclusion on December 19th, 2025, after a 16-year-long journey. The historical fantasy manga debuted in 2009 as a monthly series, earning praise for its gorgeous art, unique storytelling, and lovable characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Yū Nomiya Launches New Koroshiya no Eigyōjutsu Manga on June 15
content: The official X/Twitter account for Kodansha 's Magapoke app revealed on Sunday that Yū Nomiya and Fuji will launch a new manga titled Koroshiya no Eigyōjutsu (An Assassin's Tradecraft) on June 15. Nomiya is writing the story, and Fuji will draw the art.
author: ANN

title: Takashi Sano's Bakudan Manga Ends
content: Takashi Sano 's manga adaptation of Katsuhiro Go 's Bakudan (Bomb) novel ended with its 40th chapter on May 29. The story revolves around a clueless-looking middle-aged man who is brought to Tokyo's Nogata police station for a minor assault-and-battery incident.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Look Back Film Reveals English-Subbed Trailer, Posters
content: GKIDS revealed on Monday an English-subtitled trailer and posters for the live-action film adaptation of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga. The film is currently in post-production and will open in Japan in 2026.
author: ANN

title: Super Mario Bros. Galaxy Film Becomes 1st 2026 Film to Earn US$1 Billion Worldwide
content: According to the website, the film has earned an estimated US$1,000,028,930 worldwide (US$428,527,930 in the U.S., and US$571,501,000 internationally). The website lists estimated earnings of US$160,000 for Friday, US$250,000 for Saturday, and US$190,000 on Sunday.

title: Singer Peabo Bryson Dies at 75
content: The official Instagram account for singer Robert Peapo Bryson, who went by the stage name Peabo Bryson , announced in a statement on June 2 that he had died on 5:00 p.m. EDT that evening. The singer suffered a stroke a few days before and was receiving medical care. He was 75.
author: ANN
